$comment: Google ADK's remote A2A agents: `RemoteA2aAgent(name=..., agent_card=url)` fetches the agent card at that URL (the card's own URL, `.../.well-known/agent-card.json`, or the agent's base URL), then sends the agent messages whenever the agent that holds it delegates to it: both are reported at the construction. A card given as an `AgentCard` gives a call to `{a2aAgent}`. Serving an agent (`to_a2a`) receives requests and is no call. The agent's model requests are `google-adk.json`'s.
